status: Closed — compact runner-sync receipt contract verified 2026-09-05; historical retention decision remains separate
finding: ATM-GOV-0193/0194 added gitignored runtime telemetry, but raw/high-frequency build statistics were also duplicated into tracked runner-sync receipts. At repair time the repository retains 139 historical `*.runner-sync-receipt.json` files, including legacy receipts with full incremental plans, phase timings, cache details, and runtime telemetry references rather than a minimal decision digest.
expectedBehavior: All raw statistics and logs should be written to local disk under .atm/runtime/telemetry or another gitignored log surface. This includes counters, per-run timing events, validation usage, debug logs, broker decision traces, runner-sync receipts, and other high-frequency telemetry. Git history should keep only compact decision digests, close summaries, or deliberately selected baselines; repeated raw telemetry/log/receipt streams must not be committed by default.
evidenceOrRepro: Focused regression `runner-sync-incremental-build.test.ts` now proves generated tracked receipts carry only `incrementalPlanDigest`, `tsBuildCacheDigest`, `telemetryDigest`, and the runtime telemetry pointer; it rejects raw `incrementalPlan`, `tsBuildCache`, `phaseTimingsMs`, and `treatmentTelemetry`. Isolated runner-sync dogfood, typecheck, encoding guard, and diff check pass. Detailed data continues to be written under `.atm/runtime/telemetry/runner-sync-build/**`.
followUp: The 139 pre-repair historical receipts are immutable evidence and intentionally were not rewritten. A separate, explicitly authorized retention/migration decision is required if historical evidence compaction is ever desired; future generated receipts use the compact form.
